environment.description: Ktor 2.3.4 microservice deployed on EKS (Kubernetes 1.28) behind an AWS NLB (Network Load Balancer) with TLS termination. Service runs as a non-root container with JDK 17 (Corretto). No request filtering or schema validation at the load balancer layer. The service is directly reachable on port 8080 from within the VPC. Commons-collections 3.2.1 and other gadget libraries are on the classpath via transitive dependencies from the caching framework.
